correctness.rationale: For each (q,t)=(3,3),(4,3),(3,4),(4,4), n=2t-1. Every length-(n-1) prefix class can omit at most one word because two omitted final-letter variants have identical positive-radius predecessor signatures; hence |S| >= (q-1)q^(n-1). The modular-checksum code selects exactly q-1 per class. Independent from-source reconstruction exhaustively enumerated all q^n=243,1024,2187,16384 targets, each full closed incoming ball at radii 1..t, and every selected-signature uniqueness/nonemptiness check. Each instance passed and selected sizes were 162,768,1458,12288. This is a complete finite proof for exactly four stated parameters, not evidence for arbitrary q or t.
residual_risks: No theorem for arbitrary alphabet or radius; finite exhaustive scope only.
